findings.label: Snapshot is post-upload, not pristine
findings.detail: The pre-deploy backup downloads remote_path after the dist upload step, so the snapshot captures the server with newly uploaded files already in place. This is harmless for the fail-closed guarantee (it still runs before the destructive prune) and matches the task's 'VOR dem Prune' wording. Flagged only so a future restore-from-backup isn't assumed to be the untouched pre-deploy state. No change required.

priorFindingsResolved: Backup re-implemented as recursive local download into backup.backup_dir/predeploy-<ts>/ (was server-side cp -a).
Specs (requirements.md Req 15-18, design.md deploy section) rewritten to the local-download wording, consistent with the code and task.
FTP pre-deploy backup implemented via recursive download; the prior unconditional FTP abort is gone.
Backup failures raise a distinct PreDeployBackupError with a dedicated 'Prune übersprungen' message instead of the generic connection-failure text.
FTP deploy now has test coverage (download-before-prune and fail-closed abort).
Server-side 'cp -a ... || true' error-masking removed along with the server-side backup helpers.
verificationNotes: Confirmed ordering (backup before prune) in both _deploy_sftp and _deploy_ftp; fail-closed path (PreDeployBackupError -> exit 1, no prune) for SFTP and FTP; empty-server tolerance; separation from _remote_backup/phase_backup (remote_backup_dir untouched); retention keeps newest 5 locally. Commit message reports 104 passed with fake SFTP/FTP clients, no network. Test suite not re-run per instruction.
